title: End Game Union
summary: A community-driven multiplayer game, preparing its next chapter.
story: My lifelong project. End Game Union grew from Myanmar’s Spring Revolution into a multiplayer experience made with fellow Burmese developers. It connects my love of games with the people and place I come from. Contemporary reporting documented its early announcement in 2021 and its rise to the top of Myanmar’s local Play Store chart in July 2022. That history belongs to the whole team and community.
role: Game development and the wider End Game Union ecosystem with Backbenchers Studio and fellow developers. The next chapter, Reloaded, brings the multiplayer game, progression, supporting web experience, and music together.
features: Mobile multiplayer FPS with Photon networking and touch controls.
Reloaded introduces runner and match-3 experiences alongside multiplayer progression and customization.
An accompanying web experience brings together existing store listings, gameplay, and the Reloaded soundtrack by Double U (DJ Wine) × Backbenchers Studio.
Existing Android and iOS releases; the official site currently labels the new relaunch and payment services as not yet open.
credit: Created with Daniel Kong Thar and the End Game Union team. Published historically through Shoot and Support. Soundtrack: Double U (DJ Wine) × Backbenchers Studio.

title: BurmaMart
summary: A cross-border marketplace for buyers, merchants, and everyday essentials.
story: Buying across borders involves more than a product card. BurmaMart brings local currencies, delivery routes, merchants, and the people handling parcels into one system. It gives shoppers a familiar buying experience while giving sellers their own mobile workspace.
role: Implementation across the storefront, shared backend, administration, buyer app, and merchant app for MSCT PTE LTD.
features: Buyer and merchant Flutter apps share a Laravel API, MySQL data model, and Filament administration.
Localized product discovery, carts, orders, seller catalog management, and buyer–merchant conversations.
Multi-currency commerce and country-aware fulfillment, including office handover workflows.
Android availability and pending iOS release are recorded as supplied by the project owner; both app codebases are present.

title: Golden Gates GGT
summary: Parcel booking, branch handovers, and delivery tracking in one connected platform.
story: A logistics platform for Golden Gate GGT Co., Ltd., rooted in Chiang Mai. The public website connects to staff, customer, and courier workspaces, following each parcel from booking through dispatch and delivery. The system is in an operational pilot; native app distribution and wider carrier rollout remain in progress.
role: Full-stack logistics platform implementation: the public website, shared shipment API, Laravel web workspaces, and Flutter staff, customer, and courier applications.
features: Individually identified parcels, printable QR labels, vehicle manifests, and recorded branch handovers.
Parcel trace history, partial receipts, delivery evidence, and exception handling.
Separate staff, customer, and courier workflows with role-based access.
Manual collection and cash-settlement records, with auditable updates and retry-safe operations.
notes: Operational pilot. Native app signing, distribution, and physical-device acceptance remain in progress.

title: Actually We ARe MAd
summary: A Myanmar creator platform connecting memes, media, and digital commerce.
story: AWAM starts with a very local kind of internet humor: Burmese dialogue, reaction footage, movie edits, and the community that remixes them. The work grew beyond a meme feed into a place to discover creators, find footage, and connect entertainment with merchandise and affordable digital products.
role: Full-stack platform and ecosystem implementation: the public experience, media processing, administration, mobile surfaces, and Telegram workflows.
features: Vertical reels, discovery, creator profiles, and a searchable meme-footage culture.
Next.js application with Prisma/PostgreSQL and FFmpeg processing for adaptive HLS playback.
Native Android and iOS project surfaces alongside web and creator tools.
AWAM merchandise and the @AWAM_Digital_Store_bot ecosystem, with Telegram-driven administration and approval workflows.
credit: Meme edits and creative work belong to Gwam Si Ton and the AWAM creator community; my portfolio credit is for the platform engineering.

title: STRIKERS
summary: Football scores, match details, and editorial stories in English and Myanmar.
story: STRIKERS brings fixtures, results, football news, and guides into a bilingual matchday experience. The public portal connects a Laravel publishing dashboard with a cached football data integration, making score freshness and available coverage visible to readers.
role: Football portal design and full-stack implementation, including responsive match browsing, bilingual content, editorial administration, and the football-data integration.
features: Date and competition filters, match details, search, and device-local favourites.
English and Myanmar reading experiences with dedicated article pages.
Cached provider data with visible freshness indicators and request-budget controls.
Editorial management for news, guides, promotions, and broadcast listings.
credit: Match data is supplied by API-Football. Third-party reporting, team marks, and broadcast media belong to their respective creators.
notes: Scores refresh periodically; broadcast availability depends on supplied sources.

title: Myanmar Glyph Studio
summary: Draw Myanmar letters and turn them into usable, installable fonts.
story: Myanmar typography has a beautiful complexity: stacked consonants, kinzi, vowel marks, and combinations that need to work together. Glyph Studio makes the starting point approachable with guided drawing in the browser, then connects those drawings to a real font-building pipeline.
role: Open-source font-creation toolkit, browser drawing experience, and the pipeline connecting portable glyph projects to installable fonts.
features: Phone-friendly guided tracing, stylus pressure, zoom, editable paths, and anchor positioning.
Export a draft TTF in the browser, or use the Python/UFO/fontmake pipeline for shaping-capable builds.
OpenType mym2 shaping, mark placement, and experimental variable-weight font generation.
A public specimen and font gallery show experimental faces generated with the platform.

title: Myo Taw News
summary: A news platform with publishing and media workflows behind the stories.
story: Myo Taw needs to publish quickly, keep Burmese typography readable, and bring articles and video together. The project supports a newsroom covering current Myanmar affairs and conflict, with attention to Nay Pyi Taw and local communities.
role: Backend and implementation for the news platform, content-management workflows, and public reading experience.
features: Article and video publishing with categories and a dedicated editorial management surface.
Local Laravel/Filament implementation with media import and publishing services.
Burmese, English, and Chinese navigation is available on the public site.
Tools for video ingestion, translation, and social content organization are present in the source.
credit: Editorial reporting belongs to Myo Taw News. This case study describes the platform implementation.

title: DK Gaming Shop
summary: Game top-ups and digital goods, connected to providers and order operations.
story: DK Gaming serves players buying MLBB, PUBG, in-game currency, and digital items. The interesting engineering happens between the storefront and fulfillment: product catalogs, wholesale providers, payment requests, approvals, and the team monitoring them.
role: Full shop-system implementation spanning storefront, admin management, wholesaler integration, mobile apps, and Telegram operations.
features: Next.js storefront for game catalogs, account checks, orders, and top-up history.
Wholesaler API integrations connect the retail catalog to fulfillment providers.
Telegram monitoring and approval flows support requests and order operations.
Android and iOS native project surfaces complement the web shop.

title: Welmal
summary: Storefront, admin tools, and mobile shopping for a Myanmar commerce business.
story: Welmal is an ongoing ecommerce engagement for WEL MAL COMPANY LIMITED. Its focus is a coherent shopping journey: discovery on the web or phone, clear product information, and operational tools that keep the catalog and orders manageable.
role: Commerce implementation across the web experience, backend and admin tools, plus customer mobile applications.
features: Laravel-based backend shared by the storefront and mobile clients.
Web storefront and administration, with an additional React/TypeScript admin surface in the project.
Native Android and iOS implementations, alongside earlier Flutter work.
Product, catalog, ordering, and ongoing delivery work within one client ecosystem.

title: Hledan Junction
summary: A browser journey through Yangon, in memory of map creator Madric A.
story: Hledan is personal. The original 3D map was made by my friend Madric A. It was the last map he gave me before he passed away from cancer. My work carries that gift into a real-time browser experience: a place to walk, change the light, watch the weather, and spend a little longer with a familiar part of Yangon.
role: Web rendering and interaction: adapting the map for the browser, lighting, weather, navigation, and performance work for phones and laptops.
features: Explore the district from an orbit view, in first person, or through playable characters.
Lighting and weather systems change the atmosphere across the junction.
A baked navigation and collision representation keeps movement practical in a lightweight browser scene.
Device-sensitive rendering and touch controls support mobile as well as laptop exploration.
credit: Original Hledan 3D map modeling: Madric A. Browser rendering, interaction, lighting, weather, and optimization: Thomas D. Lynn. In loving memory of Madric A.

title: SOM BI
summary: Academic performance dashboards for a university school.
story: Built as a senior project for the School of Management at Mae Fah Luang University, SOM BI addresses an administrative problem: individual lecturer records are difficult to understand at program level. The project brings those records into role-based dashboards and visual comparisons for the school.
role: Team contribution to implementation, integration, internal setup, and deployment as part of the Vanguard senior-project team.
features: Nuxt/Vue dashboards for administrators and lecturers, backed by Express and MySQL.
Integration with the university E-port KPI system across teaching, research, academic service, administration, and arts and culture.
Program mapping, evaluation-period selection, aggregate views, and individual drill-downs.
Institution-scoped authentication and role-based access. The operational deployment and university data remain private.
credit: A Vanguard team senior project for Mae Fah Luang University’s School of Management. Presented here as a public case study only; no internal dashboard or staff data is published.

gallery.title: Program analytics
gallery.description: Program-level comparison, evaluation periods, and lecturer KPI summaries.

gallery.title: Lecturer KPI overview
gallery.description: Personal performance, domain scores, and teaching and research activity.

title: EXTANT
summary: A digital stage for a Myanmar metal band: releases, performances, and an identity that hits hard.
story: EXTANT needs a home that carries the energy of the band while making the actual work easy to find. The current public experience organizes releases, performance imagery, member credits, and a history of the band around a deliberately uncompromising visual identity.
role: Ongoing band-site design and implementation, shaping music, imagery, release information, and contact into one immersive experience.
features: Release-focused presentation with dedicated music and video sections.
Band member credits and a timeline sit alongside the discography.
Live performance imagery and an editorial, music-first visual approach.
Responsive presentation and direct paths to the band’s published work.
credit: Music, photographs, and band identity belong to EXTANT and their credited collaborators.

title: Nyan Production
summary: A cinematic home for my childhood friend’s work in commercials, film, music videos, and events.
story: This project is for a childhood friend who became a creative producer. The concept is simple: let the footage speak. The layout gives the work room, uses restraint around the video, and turns a diverse production reel into something easy to explore.
role: Portfolio design and implementation, video-first presentation, filtering, and media delivery decisions.
features: Astro static site with a small JavaScript interaction layer.
Filterable commercial, film, music-video, and event work.
Poster-led loading, hover previews, and a focused video lightbox.
Optimized short clips with support for external embeds for longer films.
credit: Production and film work: Nyan and his credited collaborators. Website: Thomas D. Lynn.

title: Yoon Nadi Htet
summary: A warm, kid-friendly introduction to an English teacher and her classroom.
story: The site introduces Yoon Nadi Htet through her education, teaching experience, classroom moments, and belief that learning should be fun. The tone is intentionally friendly and approachable for families and young learners.
role: Personal portfolio website with an education-focused story, teaching gallery, and accessible contact path.
features: Clear sections for education, teaching experience, and personal skills.
Classroom and activity photographs make the teaching style tangible.
Friendly color, readable content, and a playful learning theme.
A straightforward contact section for prospective families and collaborators.

title: Hein Zaw Fitness
summary: A strong, movement-led portfolio for a Yangon fitness coach.
story: This portfolio introduces Hein Zaw as a certified personal trainer and body-transformation coach. The work brings training imagery, qualifications, services, and a clear personal identity into a focused, mobile-friendly presentation.
role: Fitness portfolio design and frontend implementation, with scroll-linked motion and reusable content sections.
features: React/Vite frontend built as a static site.
Framer Motion and Lenis support the movement-led presentation.
Training imagery, qualifications, and service information form the core story.
Responsive layouts make the portfolio usable while browsing on a phone.

title: Phyoe Dhana
summary: A film-led archive of documentary work, music videos, and stories that deserve to be seen.
story: Phyoe Dhana is a Myanmar documentary filmmaker and music-video director working from exile. His portfolio needs to make room for the people behind the stories. The site brings his films, music videos, photographs, and ongoing documentary work into a cinematic archive.
role: Website design and implementation around the filmmaker’s existing body of work and public story.
features: Documentary and music-video sections with direct viewing links.
A filmographic timeline and visual biography.
Behind-the-scenes photography with a focused image-viewing experience.
Dedicated space for the ongoing documentary project and its published support information.
credit: Films, reporting, and photographs belong to Phyoe Dhana and the collaborators credited on his site.

title: Lynn Khar
summary: A poet’s digital home, with book discovery connected to pre-order conversations.
story: Lynn Khar’s website is shaped around literature and the relationship between an author and readers. The public site presents an author portrait, individual books, visual material, and reader responses; the wider project connects discovery with practical pre-order workflows.
role: Author website and supporting book pre-order automation through Telegram and Messenger.
features: Author-focused book library with individual book presentation.
Warm, postcard-inspired visual storytelling around the poet’s work.
Telegram and Messenger pre-order workflows, as part of the supplied project scope.
A bridge between public book discovery and conversational ordering.
credit: Literary works and author identity: Lynn Khar.

title: MSCT PTE LTD
summary: A corporate home for the import and distribution business behind BurmaMart.
story: MSCT’s website tells a different part of the commerce story: the company behind the products and the marketplace. It introduces the Singapore-based import and distribution business, its food and everyday-goods categories, and how sourcing connects to delivery.
role: Corporate website implementation and the public connection between MSCT’s business and the BurmaMart app ecosystem.
features: Service and sourcing information for retail and business partners.
A clear source-to-shelf explanation of the company’s work.
BurmaMart app presentation with real product and browsing screens.
Business contact and company identity in a responsive static site.

title: EPST
summary: A personal portfolio for an economics student.
story: A student portfolio centered on an economics identity. This entry preserves the project supplied for this collection while keeping its description modest: the domain could not be reached during the September 2026 review, and a matching local source folder was not located.
role: Portfolio website project, as supplied by the project owner. Detailed features and academic claims are intentionally left unasserted until the source can be reviewed.
features: Economics-student portfolio concept.
Personal introduction and academic positioning are the stated brief.
Current public-domain availability could not be verified.

title: Thakhin Gyi — a satire
summary: A deliberately over-the-top parody website, made with a very specific sense of humor.
story: This is the troll website in the collection: a satirical treatment of the public persona “Thakhin Gyi.” It is included as an internet-culture and visual-storytelling experiment, not an official representation or endorsement of its subject.
role: Satirical website implementation, character-driven presentation, interactive sections, and visual storytelling.
features: A highly theatrical profile, timeline, and gallery.
Burmese-first presentation with deliberately exaggerated visual cues.
A playful operating-system themed section within the broader experience.
Clearly contextualized here as parody.

title: Phaung’s Beauty Lab
summary: A fragrance-listing demo exploring a softer, more editorial shopping experience.
story: A sample project for presenting beauty and fragrance products. It explores how product photography, browsing, and a cohesive visual style can make a small catalog feel considered. This is a demo, not a claim of a fully operating retail business.
role: Demo storefront design and implementation for perfume discovery and listing.
features: Home, shop, product, and about-page surfaces in the local source.
A lightweight Vite/JavaScript frontend with reusable components.
Fragrance-led product presentation and responsive layouts.
Public demo hosted on Netlify.

title: Elbaf: The Under-Realm
summary: Under the roots of a giant tree, a chained Loki is waiting to be found.
story: A fan-made One Piece action prototype set beneath Elbaf. The experience is built around exploration: a dark under-realm, playable fighters, a key sealed in ice, and seastone wards between the player and a chained giant.
role: Interactive browser experience, scene composition, procedural character work, and keyboard/touch interaction.
features: Third-person exploration with a selectable Straw Hat crew.
Hand-authored poses over generated rigs.
A small environmental quest around Loki, a key, and five wards.
React Three Fiber and Rapier with keyboard and touch controls.
credit: Unofficial fan work inspired by One Piece. Characters and the original world belong to their respective rights holders.

title: Onigashima: The Raid
summary: Take the helm, sail the storm, and approach the island of demons.
story: The raid becomes an explorable browser scene. A cinematic approach opens into hands-on sailing, diving, hidden routes, and a castle inside the skull. It is an experiment in making a fan world feel like a place you can move through.
role: Interactive scene development, environmental composition, water rendering, and navigable experiences.
features: Switch between a cinematic approach and steering through the sea.
Submarine exploration, maelstroms, and a hidden cove.
A multi-level castle route up to the rooftop lookout.
Procedural island composition and a custom water shader.
credit: Unofficial fan work inspired by One Piece. Characters and the original world belong to their respective rights holders.

title: Grand Line Fizz
summary: A fictional soda brand, a crew of character cans, and a scroll-powered voyage.
story: A 3D product-storytelling experiment that turns One Piece character artwork into a fictional drinks collection. Floating cans, scene transitions, the crew carousel, and an ocean scene connect the product presentation to a playful fan world.
role: Adaptation and extension of the credited 3D base project: character cans, content, scene work, interaction, and static deployment.
features: GLTF can rendering with character-label textures and HDR lighting.
GSAP-linked transitions and camera movement.
Fourteen character cans, a carousel, and a ship/ocean scene in the editable source.
Next.js static export for the existing GitHub Pages route.
credit: 3D base project: Meghamittal0920 / One-Piece-3D-Website, Apache-2.0. Original LICENSE and NOTICE are retained in the showcase. One Piece is the property of its respective rights holders.

title: Sage Mode Awakening
summary: A scroll-driven transformation with lightning, chakra, and a cinematic sense of timing.
story: An anime interaction study that uses the scroll position as a timeline. Base form, hand seal, and Sage Mode become three stages of a single transformation, with graphic effects reinforcing the progression.
role: Integration, presentation, and immersive-web adaptation of a credited original showcase.
features: Pinned transformation sequence driven by GSAP ScrollTrigger.
Canvas lightning, rising particles, and camera-shake effects.
A focused study in sequencing motion to user input.
credit: Original showcase by Meghamittal0920, as credited in the existing gallery. Naruto belongs to its respective rights holders.

title: Domain Expansion
summary: A hand sign, a fractured sky, and a domain unfolding as you scroll.
story: A dramatic interaction experiment inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen. Layered imagery and a canvas storm turn a short sequence into an immersive scroll narrative, with effects timed to the transformation.
role: Integration, presentation, and immersive-web adaptation of a credited original showcase.
features: Canvas-based fractal lightning and a layered storm treatment.
GSAP ScrollTrigger choreography with parallax depth.
A study in balancing animated atmosphere with browser delivery.
credit: Original showcase by Meghamittal0920, as credited in the existing gallery. Jujutsu Kaisen belongs to its respective rights holders.

title: Backbenchers Studio
eyebrow: Thomas D. Lynn · the captain’s log
summary: The ship connecting the work: games, commerce, culture, creative tools, and people.
story: This portfolio is the home port for work that refuses to stay in one category. Backbenchers Studio brings together programming, games, and curiosity about what can be built next. The cyber Jolly Roger is the flag; the projects and the people behind them are the story.
role: Portfolio design and implementation, project storytelling, and a responsive, accessible presentation of the studio’s work.
features: A navigable project collection with category filters and search.
Individual project stories, clear roles, and preserved collaborator credits.
A captain-inspired visual identity based on the supplied Backbenchers artwork.
Motion controls, keyboard navigation, static content, and a print-friendly résumé.
